description: This file defines a controller class for managing the 'latest' module in the Opencart admin interface. It provides CRUD operations such as index rendering, saving, adding, and deleting module instances, and interacts with the model to persist data.

classes.name: Latest
classes.description: Controller class for the 'latest' module extension in Opencart admin, handling module configuration, creation, update, and deletion.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the module configuration page, loading language, preparing breadcrumb navigation, fetching module info if editing, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to save module data, including permission checks, validation, and updating or creating module records.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new module instance with default data, with permission check and appropriate response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified module instance after permission check, used via AJAX.
